The jacket I wanted is sold out again. Why don't brands just make more?
Because if a brand makes too much, it loses money. Old stock is very expensive.
But they know it is popular. Why can't they make more next week?
It is not that fast. When the supplier is in another country, the fabric takes two months.
Two months? I thought there was a big machine somewhere. What happens first?
First, they make one sample. If the manager approves it, the factory starts. If not, the process starts again.
You sound like somebody who works there. So what do I do now?
I study it, that's why. If you join the waiting list, you get an email when it is back.
Let me explain how it works.

People always ask me why their favorite jacket is sold out. So let me explain how it works in our studio. Every jacket starts as a drawing. When the drawing is ready, our supplier sends the fabric, and we make one sample. If the sample does not fit well, we change it and make another one. That part takes weeks. If the production manager approves the sample, the factory starts, and that is the moment when the real money goes out. We never make too many. If a brand makes too much, it loses money, because old stock sits in a warehouse and nobody wants it. So when a jacket is popular, it sells out fast. That is not a mistake. That is the plan. If you really want one, you sign up for the waiting list, and when the next order arrives, you get an email.

I work three afternoons a week in the office of a small clothing brand, and my job is not glamorous. I check invoices. Here is how it works. When a supplier delivers fabric, they send an invoice with the amount. If the amount matches our order, I send it to my manager. If my manager approves it, the company pays in thirty days. But if the number is wrong, I do not pay it. I send it back with a short email, and the supplier sends a new one. It happens more than you think, maybe once a week. My manager has one rule. If you are not sure, you ask. Nobody gets angry when you ask a question, but everybody gets angry when the company pays twice. I study administration, so this is the part of fashion that nobody shows on social media, and honestly, I like it.
